subject: Geopolitics
title: Defining Propaganda
description: Learn Defining Propaganda in one minute.

hook.text: Every government tells stories about itself. When those stories are designed to manipulate, they become propaganda.

buildup.text: Propaganda uses emotion, repetition, and selective truth to shape opinion.

discovery.text: The word 'propaganda' started neutral: the Catholic Church coined it to spread faith.

twist.text: All nations use propaganda. Democracies call it public diplomacy. Autocracies call it state messaging. The line blurs.

climax.text: Propaganda is persuasion with a political agenda. Recognizing it requires understanding how it frames what you see.

punchline.text: Not all persuasion is propaganda. But all propaganda is persuasion.

quiz.question: What distinguishes propaganda from regular communication?
options: It is designed to manipulate opinion for political purposes
